page.seoTitle: DoubleBlock SPF 50 Facial Sunscreen Malaysia | Kaiteki
page.seoDescription: Kaiteki® DoubleBlock is a broad-spectrum SPF 50 facial sunscreen for daily use in Malaysia. Water-resistant, oil-free and fragrance-free. How to apply it.
page.leadAnswer: Kaiteki® DoubleBlock UV Sunscreen is a broad-spectrum SPF 50 facial sunscreen, made to protect against UVA and UVB rays. Its key ingredient is octocrylene, and it is water-resistant, oil-free and fragrance-free with a matte finish. Use it daily and reapply it, because no sunscreen blocks all UV.

sections.heading: What is Kaiteki® DoubleBlock?
body: DoubleBlock is part of Kaiteki® Cosmeceuticals, the clinic's own skincare line. It keeps skin moisturised and dries to a light matte finish. The full ingredient list is on the pack.
SPF is a measure of protection against UVB rays, the main cause of sunburn. Broad-spectrum means it also protects against UVA rays, which reach deeper into the skin.

sections.heading: Who is DoubleBlock for?
body: UV levels in Malaysia stay high all year, so daily sun protection matters for most people.
Skip it if you react to octocrylene or other sunscreen ingredients. Check the pack for age guidance before using it on a child.
list: Anyone who wants daily sun protection for the face
People who prefer an oil-free, matte finish
Patients whose doctor advises daily sunscreen

howToUse.heading: How to apply Kaiteki® DoubleBlock
howToUse.intro: This is general advice for a facial sunscreen. If the pack or your doctor says otherwise, follow that.

steps.title: Apply it last each morning
steps.body: Put it on after cleansing, serum and moisturiser, and before make-up. Check the pack for how early to apply it before you go out.

steps.title: Use enough
steps.body: Use about half a teaspoon, or two finger-lengths, for the face and neck. Using less gives less protection.

steps.title: Reapply through the day
steps.body: Reapply about every two hours when you are outdoors.

steps.title: Wash it off at night
steps.body: Use your usual cleanser. If it leaves a film, cleanse a second time.

howToUse.note: Keep it off broken or irritated skin. If it irritates your skin, stop and see a doctor. Shade, a wide-brimmed hat and sunglasses add to your sun protection.

withTreatments.heading: Using it around clinic treatments
body: After a laser, peel or similar treatment, skin can be more sensitive to the sun. Doctors usually advise daily sun protection while it recovers.
Your doctor will tell you when you can start using sunscreen on treated skin. Wait for that go-ahead.

Sun exposure can make pigmentation and melasma more noticeable, so daily sun protection is standard advice. Sunscreen does not treat existing marks, and it cannot promise they won't return. A doctor can assess your skin and explain your options.
Not sure whether to use it between sessions? Ask your doctor or message us on WhatsApp.

faqs.a: No. It is water-resistant, which means it stays on better when you sweat or get wet. It still wears off, so reapply after swimming, heavy sweating or towel-drying.

faqs.q: Can I use it every day, even on cloudy days?
faqs.a: Yes, it is made for daily wear. UV still reaches your skin on cloudy days, so apply it every morning. If you stay indoors, reapply before you go out.

faqs.q: Is it suitable for sensitive or acne-prone skin?
faqs.a: It is fragrance-free and oil-free, which some people with reactive or oily skin look for. No sunscreen suits everyone, so patch-test a small area first. If you have a skin condition or use prescription products, ask a doctor.

faqs.q: Can I wear it under make-up?
faqs.a: Yes. Let it settle for a few minutes, then put your make-up on top.

faqs.q: How do I get Kaiteki® DoubleBlock?
faqs.a: Message us on WhatsApp. Our team will confirm stock and the current price.
